format.label: What to show
format.description: The text shown in the bar. Words in curly braces, like {icon}, are replaced with live values: see the list of placeholders.

tooltip.label: Show tooltip
tooltip.doc: Option to disable tooltip on hover.
tooltip.description: Show a small popup with more details when the mouse is over the module.

tooltip-format.label: Tooltip text
tooltip-format.doc: The text format of the tooltip.
tooltip-format.description: What the popup shows. It uses the same placeholders as the bar text.

interval.label: Refresh every
interval.doc: The interval in which the GPS information gets polled (e.g. current speed). Significant updates (e.g. the current fix mode) are updated immediately.
interval.description: How often the module updates its information.

hide-disconnected.label: Hide disconnected
hide-disconnected.doc: Defines if the module should be hidden if there is no GPS receiver.
hide-disconnected.description: Defines if the module should be hidden if there is no GPS receiver.

hide-no-fix.label: Hide no fix
hide-no-fix.doc: Defines if the module should be hidden if there is no GPS fix.
hide-no-fix.description: Defines if the module should be hidden if there is no GPS fix.
